user.title: Add a car
user.description: Add the integration once per car. Outdoor temperature determines the preheating time, up to 3 hours.

data_description.event_titles: Use the full title, such as EARLY SHIFT. Separate titles with commas or new lines.
data_description.event_keywords: Matches the title or description. Separate words, phrases and tags with commas or new lines. One title or keyword is enough, regardless of case.
data_description.power_entity: Select the plug’s power reading in W or kW for energy estimates and power warnings.
data_description.power_delay_minutes: Power must stay below the threshold for the full delay.
data_description.notify_entity: Alerts appear in Home Assistant. Choose your phone or another device for a second notification.
data_description.post_departure_enabled: Applies to scheduled departures within the temperature limit.
data_description.power_alarm_enabled: The cable check ends when power reaches the threshold. Energy monitoring works independently.
data_description.weather_entity: Hourly forecasts estimate future heating times. The outdoor sensor controls the heater.
data_description.energy_price_entity: The sensor overrides the fixed price. Gaps in readings can leave costs incomplete.
data_description.operation_alerts_enabled: Covers the switch, outdoor sensor and calendar.
data_description.temperature_max_age_hours: Set to 0 to disable this warning.
data_description.power_deviation_enabled: Select a power sensor and at least one limit. The lower limit applies at startup and the upper limit throughout heating.
data_description.power_deviation_delay_minutes: Power must stay outside the limit for the full delay.
